$comment: Metafield and metaobject definitions the theme reads. Create these before importing products, or the product and pest templates render their empty states. seed.mjs creates all of them.

productDefinitions.name: Summary
productDefinitions.description: One or two sentences shown on cards and above the buy box.

productDefinitions.name: Unit
productDefinitions.description: Shown beside the price, e.g. '4 pack' or '32 oz'.

productDefinitions.name: Glyph
productDefinitions.description: Fallback icon when the product has no image: bug, ant, bedbug, termite, spider, flea, rodent, mosquito, spray, trap, granule.

productDefinitions.name: What it kills
productDefinitions.description: Target species. Must match the registered product label.

productDefinitions.name: Where to use
productDefinitions.description: Approved application sites. Must match the registered product label.

productDefinitions.name: Coverage
productDefinitions.description: e.g. 'Up to 500 sq ft per syringe'.

productDefinitions.name: Application steps
productDefinitions.description: Ordered directions for use. Must match the registered product label.

productDefinitions.name: Safety
productDefinitions.description: Precautionary statements. Must match the registered product label.

productDefinitions.name: Product label (PDF)
productDefinitions.description: The registered product label. Required reading for the customer and expected on any pesticide product page.

productDefinitions.name: Safety data sheet (PDF)
productDefinitions.description: SDS from the manufacturer. Must be available to purchasers.

productDefinitions.name: EPA registration number
productDefinitions.description: EPA registration number from the label, e.g. 432-1234.

collectionDefinitions.name: Is a pest collection
collectionDefinitions.description: Set true to make this collection appear in the pest finder.

collectionDefinitions.name: Short name
collectionDefinitions.description: Label used in the pest finder tiles, e.g. 'Roaches'.

collectionDefinitions.name: Glyph
collectionDefinitions.description: Silhouette for this pest. Each pest should differ — a grid of identical bugs defeats the finder.

collectionDefinitions.name: Tagline
collectionDefinitions.description: One-line problem statement shown in the pest hero.

collectionDefinitions.name: Signs
collectionDefinitions.description: Identification signs, shown as a checklist.
